description: Source code for LifecycleInterfaceConnector class managing app lifecycle events, remote object interactions, and app state transitions within WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages app lifecycle events, remote object interactions, and state transitions within the plugin.

methods.name: createLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates remote objects for lifecycle management and registers notifications.

methods.name: releaseLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases remote objects and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: isAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an app is loaded via remote object.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches or resumes an app, handling suspend and spawn logic.

methods.name: preLoadApp
methods.description: Preloads an app, possibly suspending it based on policy files.

methods.name: closeApp
methods.description: Closes an app, handling suspend, hibernate, or terminate as needed.

methods.name: terminateApp
methods.description: Terminates an app via remote call.

methods.name: killApp
methods.description: Kills an app process via remote call.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to an active app.

methods.name: getLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves list of loaded apps and their states.

methods.name: mapAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Maps internal lifecycle states to public app states.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events and updates internal info.

methods.name: mapErrorReason
methods.description: Converts error reason strings to enum values.

methods.name: GetAppInstanceId
methods.description: Returns app instance ID for a given app ID.

methods.name: removeAppInfoByAppId
methods.description: Removes app info from internal database.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is a regular file.
